title: mentha × villosa var. tenorei
intro: Mentha × villosa var. tenorei, commonly known as Corsican mint, is a hybrid species of the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is native to the Mediterranean region and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Corsican mint include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include menthone, menthol, and limonene, among others, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
